blockingIssues.description: The dist sqlite-vec resolver and regression test still allow success via repo-adjacent node_modules, so the built dist artifact is not yet proven self-sufficient for isolated temp execution.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented that dist artifacts must ship `dist/tree-sitter/*.wasm` because tree-sitter runtime asset resolution is relative to the executing entrypoint.
Documented that sqlite-vec dist-runtime verification must isolate the built artifact from repo-adjacent `node_modules`, otherwise fallback resolution can mask packaging regressions.
